summary: BTC remains stuck in a tight range around $30k fair value, with sellers showing up above and buyers below. ETH continues to struggle at $1,935 resistance after 18 months, making lower highs and lows. Altcoins generally lack compelling setups with LTC facing halving sell-the-news pressure, SOL at resistance, and BNB defending critical $210-220 level.
